activity_records.agent_class: marine-origin cyclic depsipeptide / nonribosomal peptide drug

assay_conditions.assay: SARS-CoV-2-induced cytopathic effect inhibition measured with CellTiter-Glo luminescent cell viability readout
assay_conditions.infection_condition: fixed viral input titrated to approximately 50% cytopathic effect three days post infection
assay_conditions.drug_concentration_series: increasing plitidepsin concentrations; curve fit excludes concentrations with associated toxicity
assay_conditions.curve_fit: four-parameter logistic variable-slope nonlinear regression in GraphPad Prism v9
assay_conditions.negative_control: cells not exposed to virus set as 100% viability

replicates_statistics.replicates: two representative experiments with four replicates
replicates_statistics.summary_statistic: mean and SEM plotted in Fig. 1

curation_notes: Fig. 1 image label was visually checked; values are recorded as nM and converted to uM only for cross-database comparison.
No MIC/MBC or antibacterial assay is reported for this paper; activity row is antiviral CPE IC50 only.

qualitative_or_contextual_findings.finding: Fig. 1 includes a Vero E6 drug-induced cytopathic effect curve in uninfected cells, but the paper does not provide a fitted CC50/CC10 table for this DOI.
Supplementary embedded figures show mock-infected Vero E6 morphology after 0.05 and 0.2 uM plitidepsin, but no numeric toxicity endpoint is tabulated.

toxicity_context.unrecovered_numeric_toxicity_reason: Current paper has toxicity context in Fig. 1 and supplementary morphology figures but no parser-supported or visually recoverable numeric CC endpoint table; database CC values in linked DRAMP rows belong to Ref.33495306 and are not promoted as current-paper toxicity rows.

adjudication_note: Worker-2 repair recovered three Fig. 1 IC50 antiviral CPE rows and left toxicity as contextual only because this paper does not provide a current-paper numeric toxicity endpoint table.
